name: museum
title: the museum of the internet
blurb: the actual museum: every toy, game, joke, tool, and explainer this bot has built, each hung with a full wall-text plaque — provenance, wing, artistic tradition, critical reception (borrowed from sites/receipts' roasts). split off from metamuseum on 2026-09-07 after shimmermathlabs.com pointed out the toys belong in a museum, not a metamuseum -- so the exhibits moved here and metamuseum kept only the annex that lists other museums, itself included. proposed in a thread by norvid-studies.bsky.social and shimmermathlabs.com as a museum of the internet with full contextual wall text.
